Preserve his face and costume. 1990s SNK arcade anatomy, crisp dark outline, no white halo. EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS x 6 ROWS, 36 separate full-body sprites, all facing RIGHT, same adult head size and anatomy, wide gutters, no text, no shadows. Flat solid MAGENTA #ff00ff background. ROW2 six-frame forward WALK full cycle with alternate legs, notebook under arm. ROW3 six-frame RUN with alternating foot contacts and both airborne intervals. ROW4 crouch down (first2), deep crouch (middle2), stand back up (last2). ROW5 JUMP: crouch takeoff, extend takeoff, airborne tuck, airborne descend, foot landing, recovery. ROW6 standing GUARD first2 crossed forearms, crouch GUARD next2, aerial GUARD last2. Notebook tucked securely, bottle put away for fighting. Full limbs inside each cell, equal drawing scale, no labels.
